leaves.name: separate-proc-clock-view
leaves.tests: Packaging exact-container self-run using native43_clock_probe --serve and native43_boundary_clock.prove
leaves.replaces: Only engine container /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id, if natural client and engine views are equal
leaves.implementation: Packaging may bind a declared alternate UUID fixture read-only at that proc file in the engine CPU container; actual host client remains outside; neither Python clock nor identity readers are patched; real driver status samples CLOCK_MONOTONIC
leaves.equivalence: Recreates distinct LXC/container boot-id views while preserving kernel monotonic clocks and observed zero time-namespace offsets; actual packet must fall within host send/receive bracket. Identities are retained but never compared for equality.
leaves.cannot_prove: Arbitrary machines or nonzero clock offsets. This is a CPU fixture only and must not ship into box runtime mounts.

leaves.name: real-scheduler-cutoff-with-pending-stop
leaves.replaces: Previously completed native checkpoint and still-pending worker stop replies; no replacement of the pinned AsyncScheduler.schedule, KV allocator, admission controller or Core bypass hooks in the container probe
leaves.implementation: Container probe reuses e3_native37_admission_probe.Stack (same declared reduced constructor config, real production 4048/176/1024 scheduler geometry). It projects the checkpoint/retained-request identity and replaces stop plus _drive_stop only at the absent-worker handshake, with an empty owned reply channel. Its queued request is fresh: erroneous next scheduling reserves a real initial 1024-row frame rather than simulating 101200 tokens of model execution. One actual empty scheduler tick precedes the cutoff, then real Core hooks decide each pending-stop tick. Host four-bridge component separately holds real typed cancel replies across a Core scheduling opportunity and executes the real admission entry.
leaves.equivalence: Exposes the exact None-versus-(None,False) scheduler admission seam. Negative 5c1873a source admits one unexpected frame and dirties real source leases; fixed source admits zero with clean leases. The separate four-bridge test proves certified cancel/FULL ordering without stubbing stop.
leaves.cannot_prove: Full 100-chunk model computation, GPU execution, or native TP/PP transport. CPU-only, no box evidence.

leaves.name: native43-trace-emit-faults-and-client-view
leaves.replaces: clock.view (native43_boundary_clock.view()), the client process's /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id and /proc/self/ns/time provenance reads, with a client view that differs from the engine's; qo.json.dumps (json.dumps) for trace-row serialisation; logging.getLogger(qo.__name__).info, patched through qo.logging.getLogger(qo.__name__).info, for trace-row logging. qo.MAX_OUTSTANDING_BUCKETS replaces nothing semantically: the test patches the production constant with its existing value 1 as a no-op context.
leaves.implementation: clock.view returns client provenance while prove() runs unchanged. The 'json' subtest makes qo.json.dumps raise ValueError; the 'logger' subtest makes the named logger's info raise OSError. The 'elapsed' subtest faults the fake CUDA event's elapsed_time under the existing generated-attention-device-port leaf and uses patch.object(qo, 'MAX_OUTSTANDING_BUCKETS', 1) only as a no-op context.
leaves.equivalence: view() is provenance only; prove() never compares identities (identity_equality_required False). Serialisation/logger replacements inject faults only: real release, source-hold retirement and owner cleanup execute, and trace_emit_errors is counted. qo.MAX_OUTSTANDING_BUCKETS remains 1 throughout, so no production credit/bucket bound is relaxed.
leaves.cannot_prove: Real proc views (the packaging separate-container clock split covers those), real logging-handler failure modes, or CUDA elapsed-time behavior. CPU fault injection only; no box evidence.
leaves.logger_fault: logging.getLogger(qo.__name__).info raises OSError at qsa_operation.py:657 (owner-review source reference); this is fault injection only.
